Subject: Discovery recap + request to lock exec alignment (VP/CTO intro)

Elena / Samir — thanks again for today's exploratory call. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard
- High-level goal: reduce inference latency for recommendation generation while cutting per-request cost 30% over current infra.
- Constraints: plateaued budget for Q3, strict PII segmentation requirements, and an upcoming vendor security review week of May 10.
- Pilot success metric: 95th percentile latency under 120ms and cost per 1k tokens reduced by >=30%.

Immediate asks / path to unblock
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO handshake) — needed to greenlight a small reserved capacity pilot and sign short SOW. 30–45 minutes.
2) Technical deep-dive (infra + security) — 60–90 minutes with engineering and infra leads to validate network/KMS details and runbook.
3) Procurement: confirm PoC contracting timeline and any required vendor paperwork.

Proposed windows for the executive alignment (all in PT):
- Tue May 4, 11:00–11:30am
- Thu May 6, 1:00–1:45pm
- Tue May 11, 10:00–10:45am

If none of these work we can do a short handshake and then schedule the deep-dive separately. I attached a one-page discovery recap and a draft availability ICS for quick accept.

Attachments: discovery-recap.pdf; proposed-availability.ics

Next steps (for your team)
- Reply with preferred exec slot + name of VP/CTO we should invite (Maya? her title was referenced on the call).
- Share the name and email for procurement contact if we should include them on contract timing.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time that works.

--
